source.text: Πρωῒ δὲ ἐπανάγων εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἐπείνασεν.

records.literal_gloss: Early then returning into the city he was hungry.

en.L: Now early in the morning, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was returning to the city, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was hungry.
en.B: Early in the morning, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was going back into the city, Jesus felt hungry.
en.R: Early the next morning, Jesus was going back to the city. He was hungry.

es.L: Y muy de mañana, volviendo a la ciudad, tuvo hambre.
es.B: Muy de mañana, cuando volvía a la ciudad, Jesús sintió hambre.
es.R: A la mañana siguiente, muy temprano, Jesús volvía a la ciudad. Tenía hambre.

fr.L: Or, de bon matin, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} retournait à la ville, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} eut faim.
fr.B: Tôt le matin, alors qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} revenait vers la ville, Jésus eut faim.
fr.R: Le lendemain, tôt le matin, Jésus retournait vers la ville. Il avait faim.

sw.L: Basi asubuhi na mapema, alipokuwa akirudi mjini, aliona njaa.
sw.B: Asubuhi na mapema, alipokuwa akirudi mjini, Yesu aliona njaa.
sw.R: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema, Yesu alikuwa akirudi mjini. Alikuwa na njaa.

vi.L: Và sáng sớm, khi trở về thành, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đói.
vi.B: Sáng sớm, trên đường trở vào thành, Đức Giê-xu thấy đói.
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau, Đức Giê-xu trở lại thành. Ngài cảm thấy đói.

ko.L: 그런데 이른 아침에 그분이 성으로 돌아오시다가 시장하셨다.
ko.B: 이른 아침에 예수께서 성으로 돌아오시는 길에 시장하셨다.
ko.R: 다음 날 이른 아침에 예수께서 다시 도시로 들어가고 계셨다. 예수께서는 배가 고프셨다.

decisions.choice: early: in the early morning, before full daylight
decisions.reason: The word is used of the last part of the night and the first hours of day.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: A new scene begins, so Balanced and Readable name Jesus.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on separate pronouns and possessives (él, le, lo, te, tú, su)
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject pronoun out ("tuvo hambre", "dijo"), so where the English marks "he" there is often nothing separate to capitalise. The setting covers fewer words than in English throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Matthew's historic presents kept as presents at Literal ("il lui dit", "ils disent"); the story of the two sons (21:28-30) in the passé composé at every level
alternatives: passé simple for the story of the two sons
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11 and Matthew 20: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative, and Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken. Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level, including a story told inside it, so the parable Jesus tells is in the passé composé, as the style guide sets. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on the verbs (alipokuwa, aliona)
decisions.reason: The English "he" takes the setting. Swahili carries it in the subject prefix a-, which cannot take a capital, so the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, as in John. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: The narrator calls Jesus "Ngài"; Jesus says "Ta" of himself, "các con" to his disciples and "các người" to the leaders; the verb for his speaking is "nói" (21:18-32)
decisions.reason: The forms of address the style guide sets for the Gospels, as in the Vietnamese Mark 11 and the earlier chapters of Matthew. Recorded once for the passage.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 21:18-32; "그분" (L), "예수" (B, R) in the narrative
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so respect for Jesus is carried by -시- and 께서 at every level (style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "성" (L, B); "도시" (R) for polis
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 11:19: "성" is the walled city, Jerusalem; Readable uses the everyday word.

source.text: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν μίαν ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἦλθεν ἐπ’ αὐτήν, καὶ οὐδὲν εὗρεν ἐν αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ φύλλα μόνον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ· Μηκέτι ἐκ σοῦ καρπὸς γένηται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· καὶ ἐξηράνθη παραχρῆμα ἡ συκῆ.

records.literal_gloss: And having seen fig tree one by the road he came to it, and nothing found on it if not leaves only, and he says to it, No longer from you fruit may be into the age. And withered immediately the fig tree.

en.L: And seeing a single fig tree by the road, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went to it and found nothing on it except leaves only, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to it, "May fruit no longer come from you, forever." And the fig tree withered at once.
en.B: Seeing a fig tree beside the road, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went up to it, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} found nothing on it except leaves. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to it, "From now on, may no fruit ever grow on you!" At once the fig tree dried up.
en.R: Jesus saw a fig tree beside the road. He went to it to find some figs, but there was nothing on it except leaves. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to the tree, "No fruit will ever grow on you again!" Right away the fig tree dried up.

es.L: Y viendo una higuera sola junto al camino, fue a ella, y no encontró nada en ella sino solo hojas, y le dice: «Que ya no salga fruto de ti nunca jamás». Y la higuera se secó al instante.
es.B: Al ver una higuera junto al camino, se acercó a ella, pero no encontró en ella más que hojas. Entonces le dijo: «¡Que jamás vuelva a salir fruto de ti!». Y al instante la higuera se secó.
es.R: Jesús vio una higuera al lado del camino. Fue a buscar higos en ella, pero no había nada más que hojas. Entonces le dijo al árbol: «¡Nunca más vas a dar fruto!». En ese mismo momento, la higuera se secó.

fr.L: Et voyant un figuier, un seul, au bord du chemin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’en approcha, et n’y trouva rien que des feuilles seulement, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Que jamais plus aucun fruit ne vienne de toi, pour toujours ! » Et le figuier sécha aussitôt.
fr.B: Voyant un figuier au bord de la route, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’en approcha, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’y trouva que des feuilles. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Que plus jamais aucun fruit ne pousse sur toi ! » Aussitôt, le figuier se dessécha.
fr.R: Jésus a vu un figuier au bord de la route. Il s’est approché pour y trouver des figues, mais il n’y avait que des feuilles. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit à l’arbre : « Plus jamais aucun fruit ne poussera sur toi ! » Tout de suite, le figuier est devenu tout sec.

sw.L: Na alipouona mtini mmoja kando ya njia, aliuendea, na hakupata kitu juu yake isipokuwa majani tu, na anauambia, "Matunda yasitoke kwako tena milele." Na papo hapo mtini ukakauka.
sw.B: Alipouona mtini kando ya njia, aliuendea, lakini hakupata kitu juu yake ila majani tu. Kisha akauambia, "Usizae matunda tena kamwe!" Papo hapo mtini ukakauka.
sw.R: Yesu aliona mtini kando ya njia. Aliuendea ili atafute tini, lakini hakukuta kitu juu yake ila majani tu. Basi akauambia mti huo, "Hutazaa matunda tena kamwe!" Mara moja mtini ukakauka.

vi.L: Và thấy một cây vả bên đường, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần cây ấy, và không tìm thấy gì trên cây ngoài lá mà thôi, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với cây: "Từ nay cho đến đời đời, chớ có trái nào sinh ra từ ngươi nữa!" Và cây vả lập tức khô đi.
vi.B: Thấy một cây vả bên đường, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến gần, nhưng chẳng tìm thấy gì trên cây ngoài lá. Ngài nói với cây: "Từ nay về sau, ngươi sẽ không bao giờ còn sinh trái nữa!" Lập tức cây vả khô héo.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu thấy một cây vả bên đường. Ngài đến gần để tìm trái, nhưng trên cây chỉ có lá. Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với cây: "Từ nay trở đi, sẽ không bao giờ có trái nào mọc trên ngươi nữa!" Ngay lúc đó, cây vả khô héo.

ko.L: 그리고 길가에 있는 무화과나무 한 그루를 보시고 그 나무에 가셨으나, 그 나무에서 잎사귀 말고는 아무것도 찾지 못하셨다. 그리고 그 나무에게 말씀하신다. "이제부터 영원히 너에게서 열매가 맺히지 않기를!" 그러자 무화과나무가 곧바로 말라 버렸다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 길가에 무화과나무 한 그루가 있는 것을 보시고 그리로 가셨으나, 잎사귀밖에는 아무것도 찾지 못하셨다. 그래서 그 나무에게 말씀하셨다. "이제부터 다시는 너에게서 열매가 맺히지 않을 것이다!" 그러자 무화과나무가 곧 말라 버렸다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 길가에 있는 무화과나무 한 그루를 보셨다. 그래서 열매를 따려고 그 나무로 가셨다. 그러나 나무에는 잎만 있고 열매는 하나도 없었다. 예수께서 그 나무에게 말씀하셨다. "이제 다시는 너에게 열매가 열리지 않을 것이다!" 그러자 그 무화과나무가 바로 말라 버렸다.

decisions.choice: nothing but leaves: a tree in leaf that promised fruit and had none
alternatives: a tree out of season with no promise of fruit
decisions.reason: Fig trees put out small early figs with their leaves in spring. A tree full of leaves but bare of these had nothing to give.

decisions.choice: the withering: an acted sign of judgment on a fruitless people
alternatives: an act of anger at the tree
decisions.reason: The prophets picture Israel as a fig tree that God finds without fruit (Jeremiah 8:13; Micah 7:1). Matthew places the sign beside the temple scene and the parables about fruit (21:34, 41, 43).

decisions.choice: one: a single tree standing alone
decisions.reason: The word can mean only "a", but it may point to one tree by itself along the road.

decisions.choice: may no fruit come from you: a curse, spoken as a wish
decisions.reason: The verb is a wish or command in form. It takes effect at once.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: to find some figs; will (for may)
decisions.reason: Readable says why Jesus went to the tree, as 21:18 implies, and gives the curse as a firm statement.

decisions.choice: "cây vả" for the fig tree (21:19-21)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 11:13: "cây vả" is the established Bible name for the fig; "cây sung" is a related local tree and would mislead.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" for the tree addressed; "nói" (L) with no "đã"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:14: "ngươi" is the solemn form for an address that pronounces a sentence. Literal keeps Matthew's present "says" by leaving out the past marker.

decisions.choice: A wish at Literal ("맺히지 않기를"); a future of judgment at Balanced and Readable ("맺히지 않을 것이다")
decisions.reason: The curse is a wish in the Greek (meaning decision); a Korean wish spoken to a tree sounds weak outside Literal, so Balanced and Readable say it as a sentence that will come true, as in the Korean Mark 11:14.

decisions.choice: Present "말씀하신다" (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Matthew's present tense of narration, as the Korean Matthew does elsewhere.

source.text: καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες· Πῶς παραχρῆμα ἐξηράνθη ἡ συκῆ;

records.literal_gloss: And having seen the disciples marveled saying, How immediately withered the fig tree?

en.L: And when the disciples saw [it], they marveled, saying, "How did the fig tree wither at once?"
en.B: The disciples were astonished when they saw this. "How did the fig tree dry up so quickly?" they asked.
en.R: The followers saw this and were amazed. They asked, "How did the fig tree dry up so fast?"

es.L: Y al ver [esto], los discípulos se maravillaron, diciendo: «¿Cómo se secó al instante la higuera?».
es.B: Los discípulos se asombraron al verlo. «¿Cómo es que la higuera se secó tan pronto?», preguntaron.
es.R: Los discípulos vieron esto y se quedaron asombrados. Preguntaron: «¿Cómo se secó la higuera tan rápido?».

fr.L: Et voyant [cela], les disciples s’étonnèrent, disant : « Comment le figuier a-t-il séché aussitôt ? »
fr.B: En voyant cela, les disciples furent stupéfaits. « Comment le figuier s’est-il desséché si vite ? » demandèrent-ils.
fr.R: Les disciples ont vu cela et ils ont été très étonnés. Ils ont demandé : « Comment le figuier a-t-il pu sécher si vite ? »

sw.L: Na wanafunzi walipoona [hayo], walishangaa, wakisema, "Mtini umekaukaje papo hapo?"
sw.B: Wanafunzi walishangaa walipoona hayo. Wakauliza, "Mtini umekaukaje haraka hivi?"
sw.R: Wanafunzi wa Yesu waliona hayo, wakashangaa sana. Wakauliza, "Mtini umekaukaje haraka namna hii?"

vi.L: Và khi thấy [vậy], các môn đồ kinh ngạc, nói rằng: "Sao cây vả lại khô đi ngay lập tức như vậy?"
vi.B: Thấy vậy, các môn đồ kinh ngạc hỏi: "Sao cây vả lại khô héo nhanh đến thế?"
vi.R: Các môn đồ thấy vậy thì rất ngạc nhiên. Họ hỏi: "Sao cây vả khô héo nhanh như vậy?"

ko.L: 그리고 제자들이 [그것을] 보고 놀라며 말했다. "어떻게 무화과나무가 곧바로 말라 버렸습니까?"
ko.B: 제자들이 이것을 보고 놀라서 물었다. "어떻게 무화과나무가 그렇게 빨리 말라 버렸습니까?"
ko.R: 제자들이 이것을 보고 깜짝 놀랐다. 그들이 예수께 물었다. "어떻게 무화과나무가 이렇게 빨리 말라 버렸습니까?"

decisions.choice: how so quickly: amazement at the speed
decisions.reason: The disciples ask how it could happen at once, not why Jesus did it.

decisions.choice: The disciples ask in 합쇼체 ("말라 버렸습니까")
decisions.reason: People speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 (style guide, section 4).

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν καὶ μὴ διακριθῆτε, οὐ μόνον τὸ τῆς συκῆς ποιήσετε, ἀλλὰ κἂν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ εἴπητε· Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, γενήσεται·

records.literal_gloss: Answering then the Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, if you have faith and not doubt, not only the of the fig tree you will do, but even if to the mountain this you say, Be taken up and be cast into the sea, it will happen;

en.L: And answering, Jesus said to them, "Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what [was done to] the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' it will happen.
en.B: Jesus answered them, "Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will do more than what was done to this fig tree. Even if you tell this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' it will be done.
en.R: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth. If you have faith and do not doubt, you will be able to do what was done to this fig tree. And you will do even more. You could say to this mountain, 'Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,' and it would happen.

es.L: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} fe y no {{plural_you:dudan|dudáis}}, no solo {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} lo de la higuera, sino que aun si a este monte le {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Sé levantado y arrojado al mar”, sucederá.
es.B: Jesús les respondió: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} fe y no {{plural_you:dudan|dudáis}}, no solo {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} lo que se hizo con esta higuera. Incluso si a este monte le {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Sé arrancado de aquí y arrojado al mar”, así sucederá.
es.R: Jesús les respondió: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} fe y no {{plural_you:dudan|dudáis}}, {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} hacer lo que se hizo con esta higuera. Y {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} cosas aún mayores. {{plural_you:Podrían|Podríais}} decirle a este monte: “Sé levantado y arrojado al mar”, y así sucedería.

fr.L: Et Jésus, répondant, leur dit : « En vérité, je vous le dis : si vous avez foi et ne doutez pas, non seulement vous ferez ce [qui a été fait] au figuier, mais même si vous dites à cette montagne : “Sois enlevée et jetée dans la mer”, cela arrivera.
fr.B: Jésus leur répondit : « En vérité, je vous le dis, si vous avez foi et que vous ne doutez pas, vous ferez plus que ce qui a été fait à ce figuier. Même si vous dites à cette montagne : “Soulève-toi et jette-toi dans la mer”, cela se fera.
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : si vous avez foi et que vous ne doutez pas, vous pourrez faire ce que j’ai fait à ce figuier. Et vous ferez encore plus. Vous pourriez dire à cette montagne : “Soulève-toi et jette-toi dans la mer !” Et cela arriverait.

sw.L: Na Yesu akajibu, akawaambia, "Kweli nawaambia, mkiwa na imani na msipokuwa na shaka, si kwamba mtafanya lile la mtini peke yake, bali hata mkiuambia mlima huu, 'Uinuliwe na utupwe baharini,' itatokea.
sw.B: Yesu akawajibu, "Kweli nawaambia, mkiwa na imani na msipokuwa na shaka, mtafanya zaidi ya lile lililofanyika kwa mtini huu. Hata mkiuambia mlima huu, 'Uinuliwe na kutupwa baharini,' itafanyika.
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Nawaambia ukweli: mkiwa na imani na msipokuwa na shaka, mtaweza kufanya lile lililofanyika kwa mtini huu. Tena mtafanya hata zaidi. Mngeweza kuuambia mlima huu, 'Uinuliwe na kutupwa baharini,' na ingetokea.

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu đáp lời và nói với họ: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, nếu các con có đức tin và không nghi ngờ, các con không chỉ làm được điều [đã xảy ra cho] cây vả, mà ngay cả nếu các con nói với núi này: 'Hãy nhấc lên và quăng xuống biển,' thì điều đó cũng sẽ xảy ra.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, nếu các con có đức tin và không nghi ngờ, các con sẽ làm được không chỉ điều đã xảy ra cho cây vả này. Ngay cả khi các con bảo núi này: 'Hãy nhấc lên và lao xuống biển,' thì việc đó cũng sẽ thành.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta nói thật với các con: Nếu các con có đức tin và không nghi ngờ, các con sẽ làm được điều đã xảy ra cho cây vả này. Các con còn làm được nhiều hơn thế nữa. Các con có thể bảo núi này: 'Hãy nhấc lên và lao xuống biển!' và điều đó sẽ xảy ra.

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 대답하여 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 믿음이 있고 의심하지 않으면, 무화과나무에 [된] 일을 할 뿐만 아니라, 이 산에게 '들려서 바다에 던져져라' 하고 말하더라도 그대로 될 것이다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 대답하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 믿음을 가지고 의심하지 않으면, 이 무화과나무에 일어난 일을 할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 이 산을 보고 '들려서 바다에 빠져라' 하고 말해도 그대로 될 것이다.
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 분명히 말한다. 너희가 하나님을 믿고 의심하지 않으면, 이 무화과나무에 일어난 일을 너희도 할 수 있다. 그보다 더 큰 일도 할 수 있다. 너희가 이 산에게 '번쩍 들려서 바다에 던져져라!' 하고 말해도 그대로 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: faith and not doubting: trust in God that does not waver
decisions.reason: To doubt is to be divided, wavering between trust and distrust. Jesus spoke of faith that moves a mountain in 17:20 too.

decisions.choice: moving a mountain: doing what seems impossible
alternatives: a literal plan to move hills
decisions.reason: Removing mountains was a picture of the impossible (Isaiah 40:4; Zechariah 4:7). Jesus speaks with the same picture in 17:20.

decisions.choice: this mountain: probably the Mount of Olives
decisions.reason: They are walking from Bethany over the Mount of Olives to the city. From there the Dead Sea can be seen. Some see the temple mount meant.

decisions.choice: be lifted up and thrown: God is the one who acts
decisions.reason: The passive leaves the actor unnamed; it is God who answers faith.

decisions.choice: the fig tree first, then even more
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long comparison into short sentences.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage; it covers 21:31. Jesus speaks to the disciples, so every plural "you" is the ustedes / vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: Sé levantado y arrojado (L, R); Sé arrancado de aquí y arrojado (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek verbs are passive: God is the one who lifts and throws (meaning decision m4). "Quítate y échate" would be more usual Spanish but would make the mountain do it, so the passive is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus's solemn formula, as in Mark and Luke.

decisions.choice: Soulève-toi et jette-toi dans la mer (B, R)
alternatives: Sois soulevée et jetée dans la mer
decisions.reason: The Greek passives say that God does it (m4); Literal keeps them, but a French passive spoken to a mountain sounds stiff aloud, so Balanced and Readable use the command as in Mark 11:23.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage; it covers 21:31.

decisions.choice: Uinuliwe na kutupwa (be lifted and thrown), passive
decisions.reason: The Greek verbs are passive: God is the one who acts (meaning decision m4). An active command to the mountain would make the mountain do it, so the passive subjunctive is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R) for "Truly I tell you"
decisions.reason: The settled form for Jesus's "amen" in the Gospels (Matthew 17:20; Mark 11:23). Recorded once for the passage.

decisions.choice: "đức tin" and "không nghi ngờ" at every level; "nhấc lên và quăng xuống biển" (L)
decisions.reason: "Đức tin" is the key term for faith at every level; the mountain saying keeps the wording of the parallel, Mark 11:23.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R) for amen, through this passage
decisions.reason: The settled Korean wording for the single amen in the Gospels, as in the Korean Mark 11:23.

decisions.choice: "하나님을 믿고" (R)
decisions.reason: The faith meant is trust in God (meaning decision); Readable names him.

alternatives: a promise to grant any wish
decisions.reason: Jesus has taught his disciples to pray for God's will to be done (6:10) and promised that the Father gives good things (7:11). The promise is made to that kind of trust.

decisions.choice: believing: the condition under which they ask
decisions.reason: The participle describes the asking: those who ask while trusting God.

source.text: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ διδάσκοντι οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ λέγοντες· Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς;

records.literal_gloss: And having come of him into the temple came to him teaching the chief priests and the elders of the people saying, By what authority these things are you doing?

en.L: And when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching, saying, "By what authority are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} doing these things?
en.B: Jesus went into the temple courts, and while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. "What authority do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have for doing these things?" they asked.
en.R: Jesus went into the temple area and began to teach. The leading priests and the older leaders of the people came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They asked, "What right do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have to do these things?

es.L: Y cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llegó al templo, se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron, mientras enseñaba, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos del pueblo, diciendo: «¿Con qué autoridad haces estas cosas?
es.B: Jesús entró en el recinto del templo, y mientras enseñaba, los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos del pueblo se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron. «¿Con qué autoridad haces estas cosas?», {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron.
es.R: Jesús fue al templo y se puso a enseñar. Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los ancianos que dirigían al pueblo se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «¿Qué derecho tienes {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} para hacer estas cosas?

fr.L: Et quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fut venu dans le temple, les chefs des prêtres et les anciens du peuple s’approchèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait, disant : « Par quelle autorité fais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ces choses ?
fr.B: Jésus entra dans la cour du temple, et pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseignait, les chefs des prêtres et les anciens du peuple s’approchèrent de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. « De quelle autorité disposes-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pour faire cela ? » demandèrent-ils.

sw.L: Na alipokuwa amefika hekaluni, walimwendea alipokuwa akifundisha wakuu wa makuhani na wazee wa watu, wakisema, "Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka ya aina gani?

sw.R: Yesu alikwenda eneo la hekalu, akaanza kufundisha. Wakuu wa makuhani na wazee waliowaongoza watu walimjia, wakamwuliza, "Una ruhusa gani ya kufanya mambo haya?

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã vào đền thờ, trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang dạy dỗ, các thầy tế lễ cả và các trưởng lão của dân chúng đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nói rằng: "Ông làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào?

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 성전에 들어가셨을 때, 가르치고 계시는 그분께 대제사장들과 백성의 장로들이 다가와서 말했다. "당신은 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 합니까?

decisions.choice: the chief priests and the elders of the people: the leaders of the temple and the nation
decisions.reason: The chief priests ran the temple, and the elders were heads of leading families. With the scribes they made up the council (16:21).

decisions.choice: these things: his entry, the clearing of the temple, his healing and teaching there
decisions.reason: The leaders ask who gave him the right to act as he has in the temple since 21:12.

decisions.choice: authority: the right to act, given by someone
decisions.reason: The question is who gave Jesus the right, as the next sentence makes plain.

decisions.choice: the question closes this sentence; the second question follows
decisions.reason: Balanced puts "they asked" after the first question, and the next record gives the second.

decisions.choice: right
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain word for the right to act.

decisions.choice: los jefes de los sacerdotes; los ancianos del pueblo (L, B); los ancianos que dirigían al pueblo (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used for these groups throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Readable says what the elders were, as the English "older leaders" does (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: les anciens du peuple at every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: English Readable says "older leaders"; the style guide keeps "les anciens" for the elders, which in French already names leaders by their standing (m1), as in Mark 11:27.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa makuhani; wazee wa watu (L, B); wazee waliowaongoza watu (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used for these groups throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Readable says what the elders were, as the English "older leaders" does (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: ruhusa (permission, right)
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "right". Swahili "haki" is kept for righteousness, as in John 1:12, so Readable says "ruhusa", the right to act that someone gives (meaning decision m3). Literal and Balanced say "mamlaka".

decisions.choice: "ông" for the leaders addressing Jesus, with no deity_pronoun span (21:23)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:28: "ông" is the polite but distant address of officials who challenge him; "Thầy" would grant a respect they withhold. A noun of address takes no setting.

decisions.choice: "các thầy tế lễ cả", "các trưởng lão"; "thẩm quyền" (L, B), "quyền" (R); "đền thờ" (L), "sân đền thờ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled Gospel terms, as in Mark 11:27-28; Readable uses the everyday "quyền" for the right to act and adds who the elders were.

decisions.choice: The leaders speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 but with "당신" and no honorific -시-, through 21:27
decisions.reason: They are challenging him, not asking as pupils; the cool polite form is the wording of the Korean Mark 11:28.

decisions.choice: "성전" (L), "성전 뜰" (B, R); "장로들" (L, B), "백성의 지도자들" (R); "권한" (L, B), "권리" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 16:21 and Mark 11:27-28: Jesus taught in the temple courts, and Readable says plainly who the elders were and what the authority is.

decisions.reason: The leaders want Jesus to name the source of his authority, which they claim to control in the temple.

decisions.choice: word: here a question

decisions.choice: "các người" for Jesus addressing the leaders (21:24-32)

source.text: τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ Ἰωάννου πόθεν ἦν;

records.literal_gloss: The baptism the of John from where was it?

en.L: The baptism of John, where was it from?
en.B: John's baptism, where did it come from?
en.R: Where did John's right to baptize come from?

es.L: El bautismo de Juan, ¿de dónde era?
es.B: El bautismo de Juan, ¿de dónde venía?
es.R: ¿De dónde le vino a Juan el derecho de bautizar?

fr.L: Le baptême de Jean, d’où était-il ?
fr.B: Le baptême de Jean, d’où venait-il ?
fr.R: Qui a donné à Jean le droit de baptiser ?

sw.L: Ubatizo ule wa Yohana ulikuwa wa kutoka wapi?
sw.B: Ubatizo wa Yohana, chanzo chake kilikuwa wapi?
sw.R: Yohana alipata wapi ruhusa ya kubatiza?

vi.L: Phép báp-têm của Giăng là từ đâu?
vi.B: Phép báp-têm của Giăng đến từ đâu?
vi.R: Ai đã cho Giăng quyền làm báp-têm?

ko.L: 요한의 세례는 어디에서 [온 것]이냐?
ko.B: 요한의 세례는 어디에서 온 것이냐?
ko.R: 요한이 세례를 준 것은 누가 시킨 일이냐?

decisions.choice: the baptism of John: his whole call to repent and be baptized
decisions.reason: John's baptism stands for his work as a prophet (3:1-12). The question is whether God sent him.

source.text: ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων;

records.literal_gloss: From heaven or from men?

en.L: From heaven or from {{gender:people|men}}?"
en.B: Was it from heaven or from human beings?"
en.R: Did it come from God in heaven? Or did it come from people?"

es.L: ¿Del cielo o de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}?».
es.B: ¿Venía del cielo o de los seres humanos?».
es.R: ¿Vino de Dios, que está en el cielo? ¿O vino de la gente?».

fr.L: Du ciel ou des {{gender:humains|hommes}} ? »
fr.B: Venait-il du ciel ou des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}} ? »
fr.R: Est-ce Dieu, dans le ciel ? Ou bien des {{gender:humains|hommes}} ? »

sw.L: Kutoka mbinguni au kutoka kwa wanadamu?"
sw.B: Ulikuwa umetoka mbinguni, au ulitoka kwa binadamu?"
sw.R: Ulitoka kwa Mungu aliye mbinguni? Au ulitoka kwa watu?"

vi.L: Từ trời hay từ loài người?"
vi.B: Từ trời hay từ loài người?"
vi.R: Từ Đức Chúa Trời trên trời, hay chỉ từ loài người?"

ko.L: 하늘로부터냐, 사람들로부터냐?"
ko.B: 하늘에서 온 것이냐, 사람에게서 온 것이냐?"
ko.R: 하나님께서 시키신 것이냐, 아니면 사람들이 시킨 것이냐?"

decisions.choice: from heaven: from God
decisions.reason: Speaking of heaven was a reverent way to speak of God, as in "the kingdom of heaven".

decisions.choice: God in heaven
decisions.reason: Readable says that heaven stands for God.

decisions.choice: {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}} (B), {{gender:humains|hommes}} (R)
alternatives: "des gens" with no span, as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: French must choose a noun for the people set against heaven, as in Mark 11:30, so the gender setting goes on every level where English needs it only at Literal; the same in 21:26.

decisions.choice: "loài người" with no gender span (21:25-26)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:30: "loài người" already takes in men and women, so the English people/men setting has nothing to choose between.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "사람들", "사람"
alternatives: a span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" is already inclusive, as in the Korean Mark 11:30.

decisions.choice: "하나님께서 시키신 것" (R) for "from heaven"
decisions.reason: "Heaven" stands for God (meaning decision); Readable names him.

source.text: οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες· Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ ἡμῖν· Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: They then were reasoning among themselves saying, If we say, From heaven, he will say to us, Why then not did you believe him?

en.L: And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say to us, 'Why then did you not believe him?'
en.B: They began to argue it out among themselves: "If we say, 'From heaven,' {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will ask us, 'Then why did you not believe John?'
en.R: The leaders talked about this among themselves. They said, "If we answer, 'From God in heaven,' Jesus will ask us, 'Then why did you not believe John?'

es.L: Y ellos razonaban entre sí, diciendo: «Si decimos: “Del cielo”, nos dirá: “¿Y por qué, entonces, no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?”.
es.B: Ellos se pusieron a discutirlo entre sí: «Si decimos: “Del cielo”, nos preguntará: “Entonces, ¿por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}} a Juan?”.
es.R: Los líderes hablaron de esto entre ellos. Decían: «Si respondemos: “De Dios, que está en el cielo”, Jesús nos preguntará: “Entonces, ¿por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}} a Juan?”.

fr.L: Et ils raisonnaient entre eux, disant : « Si nous disons : “Du ciel”, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous dira : “Pourquoi donc ne l’avez-vous pas cru ?”
fr.B: Ils se mirent à en discuter entre eux : « Si nous disons : “Du ciel”, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous demandera : “Alors pourquoi n’avez-vous pas cru Jean ?”
fr.R: Les chefs en ont discuté entre eux. Ils disaient : « Si nous répondons : “C’est Dieu, dans le ciel”, Jésus va nous demander : “Alors pourquoi n’avez-vous pas cru Jean ?”

sw.L: Nao walikuwa wakihojiana wao kwa wao, wakisema, "Tukisema, 'Kutoka mbinguni,' atatuambia, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini?'
sw.B: Wakaanza kujadiliana wao kwa wao: "Tukisema, 'Ulitoka mbinguni,' atatuuliza, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini Yohana?'
sw.R: Viongozi hao walizungumza jambo hilo wao kwa wao. Wakasema, "Tukijibu, 'Ulitoka kwa Mungu aliye mbinguni,' Yesu atatuuliza, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini Yohana?'

vi.L: Và họ bàn luận với nhau, nói rằng: "Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ trời,' thì ông ta sẽ nói với chúng ta: 'Vậy sao các người không tin ông ấy?'
vi.B: Họ bàn với nhau: "Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ trời,' ông ta sẽ hỏi chúng ta: 'Thế thì tại sao các người không tin Giăng?'
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo bàn với nhau. Họ nói: "Nếu chúng ta trả lời: 'Từ Đức Chúa Trời trên trời,' thì ông ta sẽ hỏi chúng ta: 'Vậy sao các người không tin Giăng?'

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 자기들끼리 의논하며 말했다. "우리가 '하늘로부터'라고 말하면, 그는 우리에게 '그러면 어찌하여 너희는 그를 믿지 않았느냐?' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 자기들끼리 의논하였다. "'하늘에서 온 것이다' 하면, 그는 '그러면 왜 너희는 요한을 믿지 않았느냐?' 하고 물을 것이다.
ko.R: 지도자들은 자기들끼리 이 문제를 의논했다. "우리가 '하나님께서 시키신 것이다'라고 대답하면, 예수가 '그러면 너희는 왜 요한을 믿지 않았느냐?' 하고 물을 것이다.

decisions.choice: reasoning among themselves: discussing it with one another
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean thinking within oneself, but they reason together as a group here.

decisions.choice: believe him: accept John's message as from God
alternatives: trust in John as a savior
decisions.reason: To believe John is to accept what he said, including what he said about the one coming after him (3:11).

decisions.choice: John
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whom they did not believe.

decisions.choice: "ông ta" for Jesus in the leaders' words, with no deity_pronoun span; Readable does not supply his name
decisions.reason: As in Mark 11:31: his opponents would not call him "ngài", so the English span becomes a plain pronoun; a bare "Giê-xu" would be disrespectful and "Đức Giê-xu" is the narrator's honorific.

decisions.choice: The leaders speak of Jesus among themselves as "그" / "예수" with no honorific
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 11:31: among themselves the leaders show him no respect.

source.text: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, φοβούμεθα τὸν ὄχλον, πάντες γὰρ ὡς προφήτην ἔχουσιν τὸν Ἰωάννην.

records.literal_gloss: If but we say, From men, we fear the crowd, all for as a prophet hold the John.

en.L: But if we say, 'From {{gender:people|men}},' we fear the crowd, for all hold John as a prophet."
en.B: But if we say, 'From human beings,' we have the crowd to fear, since they all regard John as a prophet."
en.R: But if we answer, 'From people,' then we have to worry about the crowd. Everyone thinks John was a prophet."

es.L: Y si decimos: “De {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}”, tememos a la multitud, pues todos consideran a Juan como un profeta».
es.B: Pero si decimos: “De los seres humanos”, tenemos que temer a la gente, porque todos ven a Juan como un profeta».
es.R: Pero si respondemos: “De la gente”, tendremos problemas con la multitud. Todos creen que Juan era un profeta».

fr.L: Mais si nous disons : “Des {{gender:humains|hommes}}”, nous craignons la foule, car tous tiennent Jean pour un prophète. »
fr.B: Mais si nous disons : “Des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}}”, nous avons tout à craindre de la foule, car tous considèrent Jean comme un prophète. »
fr.R: Mais si nous répondons : “Des {{gender:humains|hommes}}”, alors nous aurons des problèmes avec la foule. Tout le monde pense que Jean était un prophète. »

sw.L: Lakini tukisema, 'Kutoka kwa wanadamu,' tunauogopa umati, kwa maana wote wanamhesabu Yohana kama nabii."
sw.B: Lakini tukisema, 'Ulitoka kwa binadamu,' tunauogopa umati wa watu, kwa sababu wote wanamchukulia Yohana kuwa nabii."
sw.R: Lakini tukijibu, 'Ulitoka kwa watu,' itatubidi tuuogope umati. Kila mtu anaamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii."

vi.L: Còn nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ loài người,' thì chúng ta sợ đám đông, vì mọi người đều xem Giăng là một nhà tiên tri."
vi.B: Còn nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ loài người,' thì phải sợ đám đông, vì ai nấy đều xem Giăng là một nhà tiên tri."
vi.R: Nhưng nếu chúng ta trả lời: 'Từ loài người,' thì chúng ta phải lo về đám đông. Ai cũng tin rằng Giăng là một nhà tiên tri."

ko.L: 그러나 우리가 '사람들로부터'라고 말하면, 우리는 무리가 두렵다. 모두가 요한을 예언자로 여기고 있기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그렇다고 '사람에게서 온 것이다' 하자니 무리가 두렵다. 모두가 요한을 예언자로 여기고 있으니 말이다."
ko.R: 그렇다고 '사람들이 시킨 것이다'라고 대답하면, 사람들이 무슨 짓을 할지 걱정이다. 모든 사람이 요한을 예언자로 생각하기 때문이다."

decisions.choice: the sentence breaks off: fear takes the place of the result
decisions.reason: They do not finish the thought "if we say this, then ...". They name their fear instead.

decisions.choice: they all hold John as a prophet: the people's high regard for John
decisions.reason: Crowds from all Judea had gone out to John (3:5). Jesus himself called him a prophet and more (11:9).

decisions.choice: The broken-off sentence: "말하면, 우리는 무리가 두렵다" (L); "하자니 무리가 두렵다" (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek breaks off and puts the fear where the result should be (meaning decision); Korean "-자니" leaves the thought hanging in the same way.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπαν· Οὐκ οἴδαμεν.

records.literal_gloss: And answering Jesus they said, Not we know.

en.L: And answering Jesus, they said, "We do not know."
en.B: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know."
en.R: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know."

es.L: Y respondiendo a Jesús, dijeron: «No sabemos».
es.B: Así que respondieron a Jesús: «No lo sabemos».
es.R: Así que respondieron a Jesús: «No lo sabemos».

fr.L: Et répondant à Jésus, ils dirent : « Nous ne savons pas. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent donc à Jésus : « Nous ne savons pas. »
fr.R: Alors ils ont répondu à Jésus : « Nous ne savons pas. »

sw.L: Na wakimjibu Yesu, walisema, "Hatujui."
sw.B: Basi wakamjibu Yesu, "Hatujui."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, "Hatujui."

vi.L: Và họ trả lời Đức Giê-xu, nói: "Chúng tôi không biết."
vi.B: Vậy họ trả lời Đức Giê-xu: "Chúng tôi không biết."
vi.R: Vì thế họ trả lời Đức Giê-xu: "Chúng tôi không biết."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 예수께 대답하여 말했다. "우리는 모르겠습니다."
ko.B: 그래서 그들은 예수께 "우리는 모르겠습니다" 하고 대답하였다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 예수께 대답했다. "우리는 모르겠습니다."

decisions.choice: we do not know: a refusal to answer
alternatives: a real admission that they did not know
decisions.reason: Their reasoning in 21:25-26 shows that they choose not to commit themselves.

source.text: ἔφη αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτός· Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

records.literal_gloss: Said to them also he, Neither I tell you by what authority these things I do.

en.L: He also said to them, "Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
en.B: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Then I will not tell you either by what authority I do these things.
en.R: Jesus said, "Then I will not tell you either what right I have to do these things.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} a su vez les dijo: «Pues yo tampoco {{plural_you:les|os}} digo con qué autoridad hago estas cosas.
es.B: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les respondió: «Entonces yo tampoco {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a decir con qué autoridad hago estas cosas.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Entonces yo tampoco {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a decir con qué derecho hago estas cosas.

fr.L: Il leur dit, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi : « Moi non plus, je ne vous dis pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.
fr.B: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Alors moi non plus, je ne vous dirai pas par quelle autorité je fais cela.
fr.R: Jésus a dit : « Alors moi non plus, je ne vous dirai pas quel droit j’ai de faire ces choses.

sw.L: Yeye naye akawaambia, "Hata {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} siwaambii ninafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani.
sw.B: Naye akawaambia, "Basi, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia sitawaambia ninafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani.
sw.R: Yesu akasema, "Basi, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia sitawaambia nina ruhusa gani ya kufanya mambo haya.

vi.L: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng nói với họ: "Ta cũng không nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào."
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Vậy thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy thẩm quyền nào mà làm những việc này."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói: "Vậy thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không cho các người biết ai đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} quyền làm những việc này."

ko.L: 그분도 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "나도 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말하지 않겠다.
ko.B: 예수께서도 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그렇다면 나도 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말하지 않겠다.
ko.R: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "그렇다면 나도 내가 무슨 권리로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말하지 않겠다.

decisions.choice: neither do I tell you: Jesus will not answer those who will not answer
decisions.reason: Jesus keeps the bargain of 21:24. The parables that follow still show where he stands.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus.

source.text: Τί δὲ ὑμῖν δοκεῖ;

records.literal_gloss: What but to you seems?

en.L: But what do you think?
en.B: Now tell me what you think.
en.R: What do you think about this?

es.L: Pero ¿qué {{plural_you:les|os}} parece?
es.B: Ahora {{plural_you:díganme|decidme}} qué {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}}.
es.R: ¿Qué {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} de esto?

fr.L: Mais que vous en semble ?
fr.B: Dites-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} maintenant ce que vous en pensez.
fr.R: Que pensez-vous de ceci ?

sw.L: Lakini ninyi mnaonaje?
sw.B: Basi, niambieni mnaonaje.
sw.R: Mnafikiri nini kuhusu jambo hili?

vi.L: Nhưng các người nghĩ thế nào?
vi.B: Bây giờ hãy cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} biết các người nghĩ sao.
vi.R: Các người nghĩ sao về chuyện này?

ko.L: 그런데 너희 생각은 어떠하냐?
ko.B: 너희 생각은 어떠냐?
ko.R: 이 이야기를 듣고 너희는 어떻게 생각하느냐?

decisions.choice: what do you think: an invitation to judge the story
decisions.reason: Jesus asks his hearers to give a verdict, as he does in 18:12 and 22:42. Their answer will judge them (21:31).

source.text: ἄνθρωπος εἶχεν τέκνα δύο.

records.literal_gloss: A man had children two.

en.L: A man had two children.
en.B: A man had two sons.
en.R: There was a man who had two sons.

es.L: Un hombre tenía dos hijos.
es.B: Un hombre tenía dos hijos.
es.R: Había un hombre que tenía dos hijos.

fr.L: Un homme avait deux enfants.
fr.B: Un homme avait deux fils.
fr.R: Il y avait un homme qui avait deux fils.

sw.L: Mtu mmoja alikuwa na watoto wawili.
sw.B: Mtu fulani alikuwa na wana wawili.
sw.R: Palikuwa na mtu mmoja mwenye wana wawili wa kiume.

vi.L: Một người có hai đứa con.
vi.B: Một người kia có hai con trai.
vi.R: Có một người cha có hai con trai.

ko.L: 어떤 사람에게 자녀 둘이 있었다.
ko.B: 어떤 사람에게 아들이 둘 있었다.
ko.R: 아들 둘을 둔 사람이 있었다.

decisions.choice: children: here two sons
decisions.reason: The word means children, but the forms in 21:29-30 show both are sons.

decisions.choice: children (L); sons (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the general word; Balanced and Readable say what the story shows.

decisions.choice: no spans for the father
alternatives: spans on he and his for the father
decisions.reason: The father is a figure in a parable, so his pronouns take no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: hijos at every level
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" means both "children" and "sons", so one word carries what the English splits between Literal and Balanced (meaning decision m1). No gender setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "hai đứa con" (L); "hai con trai" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "children", which Vietnamese "con" also leaves open; Balanced and Readable say they were sons, as the meaning decision does. No gender span is needed for the father, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "자녀" (L); "아들" (B, R); no gender span
decisions.reason: The two children are sons in the story (meaning decision): Literal keeps the Greek "children", Balanced and Readable say "sons"; since they are particular sons, this is not a gender setting.

source.text: προσελθὼν τῷ πρώτῳ εἶπεν· Τέκνον, ὕπαγε σήμερον ἐργάζου ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι.

records.literal_gloss: Having come to the first he said, Child, go today work in the vineyard.

en.L: Coming to the first, he said, 'Child, go today, work in the vineyard.'
en.B: He came to the first one and said, 'Go and work in the vineyard today, son.'
en.R: The father went to the first son and said, 'Son, go and work in the vineyard today.'

es.L: Acercándose al primero, le dijo: “Hijo, ve hoy, trabaja en la viña”.
es.B: Se acercó al primero y le dijo: “Hijo mío, hoy ve a trabajar en la viña”.
es.R: El padre fue a ver al primer hijo y le dijo: “Hijo, ve hoy a trabajar en la viña”.

decisions.choice: the first son refuses and then goes; the second agrees and does not go: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the order reversed, with the first son agreeing and not going, and the answer "the last" in 21:31
the order of the SBLGNT, but with the answer "the last"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts tell this parable in three forms. Some important early ones reverse the two sons and have the answer "the last". A few others keep this order but give the answer "the last", which makes the leaders answer wrongly. The meaning of the parable is the same in the first two forms. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: changed his mind: regretted his answer and turned around
decisions.reason: The verb means to regret and change course. Jesus uses it again in 21:32 of those who did not change their minds and believe.

decisions.choice: he was sorry. He changed his mind
decisions.reason: Readable gives both sides of the verb: regret and a change of course.

decisions.choice: cambiar de parecer
decisions.reason: This verb is regret that turns a person around (meaning decision m2), not the word for repentance that "arrepentirse" renders elsewhere in Matthew. "Cambiar de parecer" returns in 21:32 for the same verb.

decisions.choice: s’étant ravisé (L); il s’est ravisé (B); il a regretté ... il a changé d’avis (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is regret that turns a man around (m2), not the usual word for repentance, so French avoids "se repentir"; "se raviser" says a change of mind after second thoughts. Literal and Balanced use "ravisé" again in 21:32, where the same verb comes back (m2 there).

decisions.choice: kubadili nia (change one's mind)
decisions.reason: This verb is regret that turns a person around (meaning decision m2), not the word for repentance that "kutubu" renders elsewhere in Matthew. "Kubadili nia" returns in 21:32 for the same verb.

decisions.choice: "hối hận" (L, R); "đổi ý" (B, R) for the son's change of mind
decisions.reason: The verb is regret that turns a person around, not the usual word for repentance, which "ăn năn" renders; the same Vietnamese words return in 21:32, where the meaning decision links the two.

decisions.choice: "뉘우치다" (L); "마음을 고쳐먹다" (B); "잘못했다고 생각하다... 마음을 바꾸다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is regret that turns a person around, not the usual word for repentance (meaning decision); "회개하다" would point to that other word. The same words come back in 21:32. The sons speak to their father in 합쇼체.

ko.L: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하신다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 세리들과 창녀들이 너희보다 앞서 하나님의 나라에 들어가고 있다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "진실로 너희에게 말한다. 세리들과 창녀들이 너희보다 먼저 하나님의 나라에 들어가고 있다.

decisions.choice: are going ahead of you: they enter first, and the leaders have not yet entered
decisions.reason: The verb means to go before someone. It leaves the door open for the leaders, though 21:43 warns that the kingdom will be taken from them.

decisions.choice: tax collectors and prostitutes: people the devout counted as beyond hope
decisions.reason: Tax collectors worked for the rulers and were known for cheating (9:10-11). Prostitutes lived plainly against the law. Both are named as those who believed John (21:32).

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: God's kingdom
decisions.reason: Readable uses the shorter form, as in 4:23.

decisions.choice: los publicanos (L); los cobradores de impuestos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. "Publicanos" is the traditional word; Balanced and Readable say what these men did.

decisions.choice: les collecteurs d’impôts et les prostituées
decisions.reason: The style guide's term for tax collectors, at every level; "publicains" is a word few readers now know. Readable says "le royaume de Dieu" too, where the English shortens to "God's kingdom".

decisions.choice: "những người thu thuế" and "những gái mại dâm" at every level
decisions.reason: "Người thu thuế" is the word of Matthew 10:3 and 11:19. "Gái mại dâm" is the plain modern word, neither the literary "kỹ nữ" nor the coarse "đĩ"; it names the people the devout counted as beyond hope (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" at every level, beside Matthew's usual "vương quốc thiên đàng"
decisions.reason: Here the Greek says "kingdom of God", not "of the heavens", so Vietnamese keeps the difference, as in 12:28; the words are those of the Vietnamese Mark 12:34.

decisions.choice: "세리들" (L, B), "세금을 걷는 사람들" (R); "창녀들" (L, B), "몸을 파는 여자들" (R)
decisions.reason: "세리" as in the Korean Matthew 5:46 and 10:3. "창기" is the older church word; "창녀" is plain modern Korean, and Readable describes the people instead.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라" here, not "천국", at every level
decisions.reason: Matthew writes "kingdom of God" here, not his usual "kingdom of the heavens"; as in the Korean Matthew 12:28.

source.text: ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάννης πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ὁδῷ δικαιοσύνης, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ· οἱ δὲ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐπίστευσαν αὐτῷ· ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰδόντες οὐδὲ μετεμελήθητε ὕστερον τοῦ πιστεῦσαι αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Came for John to you in way of righteousness, and not you believed him; the but tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him; you but having seen not even regretted afterward to believe him.

en.L: For John came to you in [the] way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him; and you, having seen [it], did not even change your minds afterward to believe him.
en.B: For John came to you showing the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him. But the tax collectors and the prostitutes did believe him. And even after you saw that, you did not change your minds later and believe him.
en.R: John came to show you the righteous way to live, and you did not believe him. But the tax collectors and prostitutes believed him. You saw this happen. But even then you did not change your minds and believe him.

es.L: Porque vino Juan a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en [el] camino de la justicia, y no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}; pero los publicanos y las prostitutas le creyeron; y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, aun viendo [esto], ni siquiera {{plural_you:cambiaron|cambiasteis}} de parecer después para creerle.
es.B: Porque Juan vino a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mostrando el camino de la justicia, y no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}. En cambio, los cobradores de impuestos y las prostitutas sí le creyeron. Y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, aun después de ver eso, no {{plural_you:cambiaron|cambiasteis}} de parecer ni le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}.
es.R: Juan vino a {{plural_you:mostrarles|mostraros}} cómo vivir con justicia, y no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}. Pero los cobradores de impuestos y las prostitutas sí le creyeron. {{plural_you:Ustedes vieron|Vosotros visteis}} eso. Pero ni aun así {{plural_you:cambiaron|cambiasteis}} de parecer para creerle.

fr.L: Car Jean est venu à vous dans la voie de la justice, et vous ne l’avez pas cru ; mais les collecteurs d’impôts et les prostituées l’ont cru ; et vous, ayant vu [cela], vous ne vous êtes pas même ravisés ensuite pour le croire.
fr.B: Car Jean est venu à vous en montrant le chemin de la justice, et vous ne l’avez pas cru. Les collecteurs d’impôts et les prostituées, eux, l’ont cru. Et vous, même après avoir vu cela, vous ne vous êtes pas ravisés pour le croire.
fr.R: Jean est venu vous montrer comment vivre d’une manière juste, et vous ne l’avez pas cru. Mais les collecteurs d’impôts et les prostituées l’ont cru. Vous l’avez vu. Mais même alors, vous n’avez pas changé d’avis et vous ne l’avez pas cru.

sw.L: Kwa maana Yohana aliwajia katika njia ya haki, na hamkumwamini; lakini watoza ushuru na makahaba walimwamini; nanyi, mkiwa mmeona [hayo], hamkubadili nia hata baadaye ili mumwamini.
sw.B: Kwa sababu Yohana aliwajia akiwaonyesha njia ya haki, nanyi hamkumwamini. Lakini watoza ushuru na makahaba walimwamini. Hata baada ya kuona hayo, ninyi hamkubadili nia baadaye na kumwamini.
sw.R: Yohana alikuja kuwaonyesha jinsi ya kuishi kwa haki, lakini hamkumwamini. Watoza ushuru na makahaba walimwamini. Ninyi mliona jambo hilo. Lakini hata hivyo hamkubadili nia ili kumwamini.

vi.L: Vì Giăng đã đến với các người trong đường lối công chính, và các người không tin ông ấy; còn những người thu thuế và những gái mại dâm đã tin ông ấy; và các người, dù đã thấy [vậy], sau đó cũng không hối hận để tin ông ấy.
vi.B: Vì Giăng đã đến với các người, chỉ cho các người con đường công chính, nhưng các người không tin ông ấy. Còn những người thu thuế và những gái mại dâm thì đã tin ông. Các người dù đã thấy điều đó, sau này vẫn không đổi ý mà tin ông ấy.
vi.R: Giăng đã đến để chỉ cho các người con đường sống công chính, nhưng các người không tin ông ấy. Còn những người thu thuế và những gái mại dâm thì đã tin ông. Các người đã thấy điều đó. Nhưng ngay cả khi ấy, các người vẫn không hối hận, không đổi ý mà tin ông ấy.

ko.L: 요한이 의의 길로 너희에게 왔는데, 너희는 그를 믿지 않았다. 그러나 세리들과 창녀들은 그를 믿었다. 그런데 너희는 [그것을] 보고도 나중에 뉘우쳐 그를 믿지도 않았다.
ko.B: 요한이 너희에게 와서 의의 길을 보여 주었는데도, 너희는 그를 믿지 않았다. 그러나 세리들과 창녀들은 그를 믿었다. 그런데 너희는 그것을 보고도 끝내 마음을 고쳐먹고 그를 믿지 않았다.
ko.R: 요한은 하나님 앞에서 바르게 사는 길을 보여 주려고 너희에게 왔다. 그런데 너희는 요한을 믿지 않았다. 그러나 세금을 걷는 사람들과 몸을 파는 여자들은 요한을 믿었다. 너희는 그것을 보았다. 그런데도 너희는 마음을 바꾸어 요한을 믿지 않았다.

decisions.choice: in the way of righteousness: living and teaching the right way before God
alternatives: only in a righteous manner of life
decisions.reason: John both lived rightly and called people to the life God requires (3:2-12). Jesus said that he and John were to fulfill all righteousness (3:15).

decisions.choice: change your minds: the same verb as the first son's change in 21:29
alternatives: repent of all sin in general
decisions.reason: The leaders are like the second son. They said yes to God but did not turn when John came, even when they saw sinners turn.

decisions.choice: to believe him: the change they did not make was believing
decisions.reason: The infinitive tells what changing their minds would have meant: coming to believe John.

decisions.choice: the righteous way to live
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the key word in its adjective form and says what the way was.

decisions.choice: "đường lối công chính" (L); "con đường công chính" (B); "con đường sống công chính" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads it as living and teaching the right way before God; "công chính" is the key term for righteousness, kept at every level.

decisions.choice: "hối hận" (L, R) and "đổi ý" (B, R), the words of 21:29
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that this is the verb used of the first son; Vietnamese repeats the same words so that the leaders are seen not to do what he did.

decisions.choice: "의의 길" (L, B); "하나님 앞에서 바르게 사는 길" (R)
decisions.reason: "의" is the key term for righteousness; Readable says what it means here (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "뉘우치다" (L), "마음을 고쳐먹다" (B), "마음을 바꾸다" (R), as in 21:29
decisions.reason: The same verb as the first son's change of mind (meaning decision), so the Korean repeats the same words.
